semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides specialized inspection and measurement systems crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Effecttek Technologies(Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. specializes in high-resolution, non-contact 3D measurement systems for the semiconductor industry. Their products leverage spectral confocal and laser measurement technologies to address precision measurement challenges such as linewidth and film thickness measurement.
capabilities: 3D measurement systems using white light and red light interferometry
Multi-layer dimensional measurements on transparent and semi-transparent materials

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Shenzhen, focusing on the domestic semiconductor and precision manufacturing markets.
